scenes.context: 畸变拉长，透视放大近处。
sentences: 现在他整个身体上面，离你最近的地方是哪里？
What part of his body is nearest to you right now?
nearest point（最近处）
腿被拉长了是畸变，脚变大、腿变粗、脸变大是透视。
Stretched legs are distortion; bigger feet, thicker legs, larger face are perspective.
distortion vs perspective（畸变与透视）
scenes.speak: What part of his body is nearest to you right now? Stretched legs are distortion; bigger feet, thicker legs, larger face are perspective.

scenes.title_cn: 解决思路：想让他的腿变长的同时不变粗…
scenes.title_en: Solution: to lengthen the legs without thi…
scenes.context: 升高机位改变透视关系。
sentences: 你站起来，慢慢再往后仰，腿就长的同时不变粗。
Stand up and lean back—legs lengthen without thickening.
raise the camera（升高机位）
你机位高起来了，这个区域离镜头近，那个区域就变远了。
Your camera rose—one area nears the lens, another goes farther.
perspective shift（透视变化）
一定要利用畸变关系，把腿拍得比他本人看起来长多了。
Use distortion to make legs look far longer than they are.
distortion magic（畸变魔法）
你透视没控制好，是不是就显得这个腿没有他这么长。
Poor perspective control makes the legs look shorter.
control perspective（控制透视）
scenes.speak: Stand up and lean back—legs lengthen without thickening. Your camera rose—one area nears the lens, another goes farther. Use distortion to make legs look far longer than they are. Poor perspective control makes the legs look shorter.

sentences: 我不给你们搞那种故弄玄虚的事，我教给你的东西就是我用的。
I don't do mystifying stuff—I teach what I actually use.
no mystifying（不故弄玄虚）
你不熟，你就多练。
If you're not practiced, practice more.
practice more（多练）
scenes.speak: I don't do mystifying stuff—I teach what I actually use. If you're not practiced, practice more.

practice: Stretch is distortion; near objects get bigger by perspective.
Sitting low with wide angle enlarges feet, thickens legs.
Stand up and lean back to change the perspective.
Raise the camera to lengthen legs without thickening them.
pitfalls: Stretch is distortion; bigness is perspective.
Shoot from a low seat for long legs.
Raising the camera height changes the perspective.
低机位拍长腿反而显粗。
Blame the lens for thick legs.
It's the perspective relationship with camera height.
Practice shooting until it's muscle memory.
shifts: 用 stretch（拉长）、perspective（透视）、camera height（机位）
用 near and far（近大远小）、proportion（比例）、look longer（显得更长）
用 muscle memory（熟练功）、practice more（多练）、what I use（我用的东西）
